scoutingParagraphs: The newly checked MLB Pipeline report identifies Levu's raw power and contact ability, with chase limiting how efficiently he accesses the impact. His likely first-base role makes better pitch selection and sustained offensive production particularly important. In the verified 2026 professional sample, he hit 0.218/0.319/0.346 over 91 plate appearances, with 2 home runs, a 16.5% strikeout rate and a 11.0% walk rate. Early pro evidence is displayed as a sample, not an established MLB skill.

Making contact on difficult pitches can still produce weak outcomes, so a low strikeout rate would not answer every question. Better selectivity on pitches he can drive could improve impact without requiring a completely different swing. The first-base standard means his on-base production and extra-base damage need to work together.
